ABOUT GENERAL AIR PRO

Experience you can trust. Comfort you can feel.

Reliable, innovative heating and cooling solutions for New Jersey homes and businesses—delivered with skill, care, and clear communication.

COMFORT IN EVERY SEASON

Built around dependable service and quality workmanship.

General Air Pro Heating & Cooling delivers reliable, innovative heating and cooling solutions backed by over 15 years of industry experience. Our skilled team is committed to keeping your home or business comfortable, efficient, and safe throughout every season.

From heating and air conditioning installation to repairs, maintenance, and system upgrades, we provide dependable service and quality workmanship you can trust. Your comfort and satisfaction are our priority—year-round.

Explore our services

15+ years

of industry experience behind every recommendation

OUR PURPOSE

Our job is to provide you with innovation.

We combine proven service experience with modern heating and cooling solutions to improve comfort, efficiency, and peace of mind.

Vision

To lead with innovative heating and cooling solutions that enhance comfort and sustainability.

Mission

Deliver exceptional service and thoughtful technology that meets each customer’s comfort needs.

Motto

Innovating comfort. Ensuring satisfaction.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Service focused on your satisfaction.
We work to exceed expectations
Your satisfaction comes first
Experienced HVAC professionals
24-hour emergency support
Heating and cooling help for New Jersey properties

General Air Pro LLC serves homes and businesses across its listed North and Central New Jersey communities, including Princeton and Edison. Our business address is 2 High St, North Arlington, NJ 07031; the town pages describe service coverage, not separate business locations. Tell us your town and the equipment involved so we can discuss the appropriate service.

How a free quote request works

A free quote starts with your description of the property, equipment and work you need. An online message or photo cannot establish every cause of a heating or cooling problem, so further assessment may be needed before a recommendation. We do not publish a universal price for jobs that differ in equipment, access and scope.

Choose the service you need and provide your address, town and contact details.
Describe what changed, when it started and whether the issue affects one room or the whole property.
Discuss the recommended work and quote before deciding how to proceed.
Choose a home visit or a video conversation

The website lets you request a home appointment or select an available free 30-minute video consult. A home-visit request is not a confirmed arrival time: the owner confirms the visit details. Video consults use available calendar times and provide a Google Meet invitation after booking.

Request a home visit when the equipment needs an in-person assessment.
Use a video consult to show accessible equipment and discuss your questions without removing covers.
Call (609) 248-6446 for urgent heating or cooling help rather than relying on an online appointment request.
Prepare useful information before contacting us

Equipment details and a clear description help us understand your request, but you do not need to identify the failed part. Share information you can obtain safely; do not open electrical panels or dismantle equipment for a photo. If you suspect a gas leak, fire or carbon-monoxide danger, contact emergency services from a safe location.

Note the make and model if the label is safely visible, plus any past service information.
Describe noises, water, thermostat messages and rooms that feel too hot or cold.
Let us know about access restrictions and your preferred way to receive a response.
Contact a licensed New Jersey HVAC contractor

General Air Pro's New Jersey HVACR license number is 19HC00888700. Contact us by phone at (609) 248-6446 or email generalairpros@gmail.com to discuss repair, maintenance or replacement needs. You can also review the service-area list before sending a request.

Tell us what your home or business needs. We’ll respond with clear next steps and a free estimate.
